land.faq.1.a: Nelvin is a savings membership for African cities. You get offers and cashback at verified restaurants, hotels, spas, gyms and shops. You can join on your own or through your employer.
land.faq.2.a: Pick an offer in the app and show it at the till. The partner scans your personal code, which is valid for 3 minutes, or the cashier enters their PIN on your phone. The offer applies to your real bill, and any cashback goes to your wallet right away.
land.faq.2.q: How do the Nelvin offers work?
land.faq.3.a: Sign up with your email, choose a membership and start saving. Nelvin opens in your phone's browser and adds to your home screen in one tap. Employees can also join with their company's invitation code.
land.faq.3.q: How do I create an account?
land.faq.4.a: You can pay by Mobile Money, card, bank transfer or with your Nelvin wallet. Prices show in your local currency, such as FCFA, naira, cedi or shilling.
land.faq.4.q: How do I pay for my membership?
land.faq.5.a: Send us a partner application with your offer and your shop's location. Our team checks your business, then your offers go live in the app and on the partner map.

lg.cookies.intro: This policy describes how Nelvin uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on the platform.
lg.cookies.s1.p1: A cookie is a small file stored on your device when you visit a website. It lets us remember your preferences and measure how the service is used.
lg.cookies.s2.p1: Essential cookies: required for the platform to work (authentication, security).
lg.cookies.s2.p2: Preference cookies: remember your language and display settings.
lg.cookies.s2.p3: Analytics cookies: help us understand how you use the app so we can improve it.
lg.cookies.s2.p4: Marketing cookies: used, with your consent, to personalise the offers shown.
lg.cookies.s3.p1: On your first visit, you can accept or refuse non-essential cookies. You can change your choice at any time in the app Settings.
lg.cookies.s4.p1: Some cookies are set by third parties (e.g. payment providers, analytics tools). These third parties use cookies in accordance with their own policies.
lg.cookies.s5.p1: Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies are kept for the defined period or until you delete them.
lg.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
lg.privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is a priority at Nelvin. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and what rights you have.
lg.privacy.s1.p1: Account data: name, email, phone number, country, account type.
lg.privacy.s1.p2: Transaction data: history of offers, refunds, cashback and payments processed through our partner PSPs.
lg.privacy.s1.p3: Company data: for HR accounts, information about the company, invited employees and allowances.
lg.privacy.s1.p4: Technical data: IP address, device type, cookies and usage data (see our Cookie Policy).
lg.privacy.s2.p1: We process your data to: provide and manage your account, display and validate offers, credit cashback, process payments, communicate with you, prevent fraud and meet our legal obligations.
lg.privacy.s3.p1: We share your data only when necessary: with partner merchants (to validate offers), payment providers (to process transactions), and legal authorities where the law requires it. We never sell your personal data.
lg.privacy.s4.p1: We keep your data for as long as your account is active, or as required by legal retention obligations. When you delete your account, your data is deleted or anonymised within a reasonable time.
lg.privacy.s5.p1: We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encryption, access control and row-level security (RLS) to isolate data between companies.
lg.privacy.s6.p1: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, port and object to the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us through the Support Center. Companies may manage their employees' data in line with their internal policy.
lg.privacy.s7.p1: Your data may be processed in countries other than your own. In that case, we make sure an adequate level of protection is guaranteed, in accordance with applicable law.
lg.privacy.s8.p1: For any question about your personal data, open a ticket through the app's Support Center.
lg.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
lg.refund.intro: This policy sets out the conditions for cancelling Nelvin subscriptions and how refunds work.
lg.refund.s1.p1: Subscriptions (Pass Basic, Premium, VIP) are billed in advance for the chosen cycle. You can cancel at any time from Billing settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period; no retroactive refund is due for the period already started.
lg.refund.s2.p1: Companies are billed based on the number of active seats. Cancellation is possible with the notice stated in your contract. Fees already billed for the current period are not refunded.
lg.refund.s3.p1: If a trial period is offered, nothing is charged during the trial. At the end of the trial, the subscription is billed automatically unless cancelled beforehand.
lg.refund.s4.p1: Cashback credited is not a refundable payment. Refunds relating to a product or service bought from a merchant fall under that merchant's policy.
lg.refund.s5.p1: Any exceptional request must be submitted through the Support Center within 14 days of the transaction. We will review each request on a case-by-case basis.
lg.refund.s6.p1: When a refund is granted, it is made through the same payment method used for the original transaction, within 5 to 10 business days.
lg.refund.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
lg.terms.intro: Welcome to Nelvin Benefits. By accessing our services, you accept these terms of use. Please read them carefully.
lg.terms.s1.p1: By creating an account, signing in or using the Nelvin platform (web and mobile app), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use as well as our Privacy Policy and our Cookie Policy.
lg.terms.s1.p2: If you do not accept these terms, you must not use our services.
lg.terms.s2.p1: Nelvin is a corporate benefits and B2C discount platform operating in Africa. Our services include: employee benefits, member offers (Individual), the merchant marketplace, multi-PSP cashback, and offline validation of redemption codes (QR/alphanumeric).
lg.terms.s3.p1: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. Account types are: Individual, Merchant and Company/HR. Employees are invited by their company through an invite code. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided at sign-up.
lg.terms.s4.p1: Offers are provided by partner merchants and may be changed or withdrawn at any time. Cashback is credited according to the terms of each offer and may be subject to processing times. Generated redemption codes have an expiry date and are only valid with participating merchants.
lg.terms.s4.p2: Nelvin is not responsible for the quality of the products or services provided by merchants.
lg.terms.s5.p1: Payments are processed through several payment service providers (PSPs) depending on your region. By subscribing, you authorise Nelvin to charge the amount shown for the chosen cycle (monthly or annual). See our Refund Policy for cancellation terms.
lg.terms.s6.p1: You agree not to: use the service for unlawful purposes, create fake accounts, abuse the cashback system, resell offers, or attempt to compromise the security of the platform. Any breach may lead to the suspension of your account.
lg.terms.s7.p1: Nelvin provides the services "as is". To the extent permitted by law, Nelvin cannot be held liable for indirect damages, loss of revenue or harm resulting from use of the platform or unavailability of the service.
lg.terms.s8.p1: We may update these terms at any time. Changes take effect as soon as they are published. Continued use of the services constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
lg.terms.s9.p1: These terms are governed by the laws applicable in your jurisdiction of residence. Any dispute will be brought before the competent courts.
lg.terms.title: Terms of Use

sp.h.a1: Open any offer, tap Redeem, and show the generated QR code or 6-digit code to the merchant. Codes are valid for 3 minutes and work offline.
sp.h.a2: Cashback is credited to your Nelvin wallet within 24 hours of a successful redemption. VIP members receive priority crediting.
sp.h.a3: Yes. Pass Premium and VIP unlock offers across all partner cities in Africa. Your wallet converts automatically to local currency.
sp.h.a4: Go to your wallet and tap Withdraw to transfer to Mobile Money or a local bank account. Withdrawals are usually instant.
sp.h.a5: Simply tap Redeem again to generate a fresh code. No rewards are lost when a code expires before use.
